;International relations
*[[Chad–Israel relations]]
**[[Chad]] and [[Israel]] restore diplomatic relations with each other after [[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] meets with [[List of heads of state of Chad|Chadian President]] [[Idriss Déby]] in [[N'Djamena]]. Chad severed ties with Israel in 1972. [https://www.i24news.tv/en/news/international/193545-190119-netanyahu-embarks-for-chad-on-historic-visit-to-renew-diplomatic-ties?utm_source=twitter.com&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=international&utm_content=en1 (i24 News)]

;Sports
*[[2018–19 NFL playoffs]]
**In [[American football]], the [[Los Angeles Rams]] defeat the [[New Orleans Saints]] in the [[NFC Championship Game]], [[2018 NFC Championship Game|26-23]], to advance to [[Super Bowl LIII]] and play the [[New England Patriots]], who defeated the [[Kansas City Chiefs]] in the [[AFC Championship Game]]. The NFC Championship game is best known for an unpenalized [[pass interference]] committed by [[cornerback]] [[Nickell Robey-Coleman]] on [[wide receiver]] [[Tommylee Lewis]], which is nicknamed as the ''NOLA No-Call''. [https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/officials-miss-blatant-pass-interference-penalty-leading-to-rams-come-from-behind-win-over-saints/ (CBS Sports)] [https://edition.cnn.com/2019/01/22/us/new-orleans-saints-super-bowl-play-reaction-trnd/index.html (CNN)]
